claim_reason: Phase 0 authorizes implementation only; final v0.4 measurements plus eligible compatibility, hosted-platform, containment, plugin, package, and comparative evidence remain incomplete.

generation_contract.source_of_truth: source_artifacts and retained evidence referenced by each dimension
generation_contract.materialization_rule: resolve every source pointer, apply the named decision function independently, and emit one row per dimension without aggregate compensation

all_required_members_pass.rule: every required member has state pass; averages, totals, optional members, and stronger members cannot compensate for a non-pass member

corrected_lower_bound_floor.rule: the preregistered multiplicity-corrected one-sided 95 percent lower confidence bound meets the member-specific floor

corrected_upper_bound_ceiling.rule: the preregistered multiplicity-corrected one-sided 95 percent upper confidence bound meets the member-specific ceiling or ratio margin

exact_equivalence.rule: canonical outputs match after only the preregistered exclusions and tolerances; the first semantic difference fails the member

hard_budget.rule: the exact value or adverse p95 confidence bound is at or below the preregistered hard ceiling

compatibility_replay.rule: every frozen success, error, exit, default, format, root, task, and normal-workflow replay passes for old and current clients

agent_non_inferiority.rule: answer quality, unsupported assertions, context tokens, reads, calls, and workflow members independently meet their preregistered non-inferiority rules against the prior release and accepted baseline

zero_growth.rule: the independently named public or workflow surface grows by no more than its explicit allowance

complete_containment.rule: every required platform and negative case proves the declared process, filesystem, network, execution, resource, cancellation, and provenance containment contract

review_clearance.rule: every required reviewer role has a current disposition and zero unresolved blocking findings

universal_requirements: all referenced source artifacts exist and validate against their declared format or schema identity and schema version
the result binds the exact phase, candidate commit, baseline commit, corpus commit, profile, environment, toolchain, operation, and decision-function version
required capabilities, coverage, limits, cache state, warmups, repetitions, timeouts, and outputs match the preregistered evaluation manifest
timeouts, crashes, invalid output, undeclared fallback, incomplete coverage, and unexpected network access remain recorded failures
required raw artifacts and digests are retained and no observed sample is silently dropped or replaced
each required platform, corpus, family, workflow, and baseline member is present and independently eligible
absolute_reference_host_requirements: the runner identity matches the frozen reference-host class
before and after calibration values remain inside the frozen raw-time envelope
the tolerance factor was fixed before results and is no greater than 1.25
measured latency is not divided by calibration
hosted_requirements: every required hosted platform result is present
the packaged artifact and managed runtime identity match the candidate commit
a local-only or uncalibrated observation cannot replace required hosted evidence

phase_readiness_gates.label: Frozen implementation contracts
phase_readiness_gates.scope: The accepted capability, compatibility-surface, graph-snapshot, budget, evaluation, verification, and simplicity contracts needed to begin implementation are frozen; final behavioral replay remains a release gate.

phase_readiness_gates.label: Decision-enabling SQLite feasibility
phase_readiness_gates.scope: The local real-SQLite lexical/FTS and storage/publication labs in ARRI-2.12 and ARRI-2.13 pass; full pinned-corpus campaigns remain a release gate.

phase_readiness_gates.label: Implementation-enabling architecture decisions
phase_readiness_gates.scope: Typed graph, lexical fallback, publication, semantic-boundary, rollback, and explicitly deferred optional-pack decisions are accepted without claiming unmeasured candidates.

phase_readiness_gates.label: Resolved Phase 0 reviews
phase_readiness_gates.scope: Every required Phase 0 reviewer role has a visible disposition and no unresolved blocking finding.

phase_exit_contract.claim_rule: Phase 0 readiness authorizes implementation only and never authorizes a correctness, performance, compatibility, platform, installation, or superiority claim

release_acceptance_contract.claim_rule: v0.4 release acceptance requires every applicable required dimension and every required member to have state pass under its preregistered decision function
release_acceptance_contract.superiority_rule: a superiority claim additionally requires every hard correctness, compatibility, determinism, containment, resource, workflow, and simplicity gate plus each dimension-specific superiority decision; non-inferiority or a stronger unrelated metric cannot substitute
release_acceptance_contract.methodology_change_rule: changing a corpus, member set, threshold, margin, sample plan, eligibility rule, or decision function after observing results creates a new scoreboard schema version and requires rerunning every affected candidate and baseline cell

dimensions.label: Accepted capability coverage
dimensions.scope: every accepted mode, normalized parser capability, entity, relation, enrichment, search, analysis, federation, snapshot, pack, tier, and required platform
dimensions.eligibility: an achieved manifest exists and every member has immutable provenance plus non-vacuous evidence for its advertised tier
dimensions.blocker: capability_registry#/achieved_manifest is null

dimensions.label: Per-language and per-relation-family accuracy
dimensions.scope: each advertised language, parser, symbol family, relation family, semantic provider, query family, and platform with non-zero preregistered denominators
dimensions.eligibility: minimum positive and negative examples are met and precision, recall, abstention, parse-error coverage, span correctness, and corrected confidence bounds are present
dimensions.blocker: no correctness measurements exist

dimensions.label: CLI compatibility
dimensions.scope: every frozen CLI command, option, default, output mode, success/error shape, stream, exit code, root rule, and normal workflow
dimensions.eligibility: golden success and failure replays cover every frozen invocation and old-client behavior
dimensions.blocker: the CLI contract remains partial until complete golden replay

dimensions.label: MCP compatibility
dimensions.scope: every frozen MCP tool, request schema, default, success/error transport, output root, root-selection rule, task contract, and old-client workflow
dimensions.eligibility: real initialized MCP replay covers every frozen request and response contract
dimensions.blocker: the MCP default and behavior contract remains partial until complete replay

dimensions.label: Full and incremental equivalence
dimensions.scope: every accepted mutation class, corpus, profile, and required platform
dimensions.eligibility: both runs reach the same repository state and canonicalize with the frozen exclusions
dimensions.blocker: no full-versus-incremental run artifacts exist

dimensions.label: Worker-count equivalence
dimensions.scope: worker count 1 versus the preregistered N for every accepted corpus and profile
dimensions.eligibility: worker counts and all other inputs match the evaluation manifest
dimensions.blocker: no 1-versus-N canonical comparisons exist

dimensions.label: Repeated-run determinism
dimensions.scope: at least ten repeated runs for every nondeterminism-sensitive enrichment and required platform
dimensions.eligibility: all declared repetitions complete and use the frozen seed, ordering, and tolerance rules
dimensions.blocker: no repeated-run canonical comparisons exist

dimensions.label: Real-process platform and Unicode correctness
dimensions.scope: Windows x86_64, Linux x86_64, macOS arm64, and macOS x86_64 with UTF-8, CJK, emoji, spaces, metacharacters, long supported paths, and available NFC/NFD cases
dimensions.eligibility: real packaged ProjectAtlas and supervised worker processes run on every required host
dimensions.blocker: required hosted platform results do not exist

dimensions.label: Parser and optional-pack containment
dimensions.scope: every candidate parser host and accepted optional pack on every required platform
dimensions.eligibility: artifact provenance, process-tree accounting, time/memory/input/output/cancellation limits, ABI, crash isolation, and offline behavior are all exercised
dimensions.blocker: ARRI-2.14 hosted parser-host and containment evidence is pending

dimensions.label: Network, filesystem, and repository-code containment
dimensions.scope: normal scan/query, parser worker, optional pack, installer lifecycle, and federation negative cases on every required platform
dimensions.eligibility: unexpected network, out-of-root access, repository-code execution, hidden download, and implicit federation are actively denied and observed
dimensions.blocker: complete hosted negative-case evidence does not exist

dimensions.label: Full scan time
dimensions.scope: cold and warm scan for every required corpus, profile, worker count, and accepted baseline
dimensions.eligibility: correctness, coverage, cache state, repetitions, timeout treatment, paired host, and output validation all pass
dimensions.blocker: evaluation_manifest#/measurements is empty

dimensions.label: Incremental publication time
dimensions.scope: no-change, one-file, dependency-fan-out, and dirty-worktree publication classes for every required corpus and baseline
dimensions.eligibility: the mutation reaches the declared state, publication is complete, and work/write coverage is validated
dimensions.blocker: no incremental result artifacts exist

dimensions.label: Complete-process-tree RSS
dimensions.scope: idle core, full scan, incremental publication, query concurrency, parser host, semantic pack, and installer lifecycle on every required host
dimensions.eligibility: the named platform metric includes every ProjectAtlas-owned child process with the preregistered sampling interval and shared-page policy
dimensions.blocker: no complete-process-tree memory results exist

dimensions.label: Physical main-database writes
dimensions.scope: full, no-change, one-file, fan-out, and dirty-worktree operations for every corpus and baseline
dimensions.eligibility: physical bytes written to the live SQLite main database are measured rather than inferred from final size
dimensions.blocker: component-specific physical database-write results do not exist

dimensions.label: Physical WAL, SHM, and journal writes
dimensions.scope: WAL, SHM, rollback journal, checkpoint, and cleanup writes for every accepted mutation class
dimensions.eligibility: each component is measured independently and overwritten same-size pages remain counted
dimensions.blocker: component-specific WAL, SHM, and journal write results do not exist

dimensions.label: Physical staging and SQLite temporary writes
dimensions.scope: staging database, import, temporary, sort, and failed-publication cleanup writes
dimensions.eligibility: all process-tree files are observed through successful and failed publication lifecycles
dimensions.blocker: physical staging and temporary write results do not exist

dimensions.label: Physical derived-sidecar writes
dimensions.scope: FTS, vector, ANN, snapshot, manifest, and every required derived sidecar enabled by the measured profile
dimensions.eligibility: all required sidecars are inventoried and both writes and retention are measured
dimensions.blocker: component-specific physical sidecar-write results do not exist

dimensions.label: Logical row and page changes
dimensions.scope: full, no-change, one-file, fan-out, and dirty-worktree mutation classes
dimensions.eligibility: logical changes are reported separately from physical writes and final file-size deltas
dimensions.blocker: no logical-write results exist

dimensions.label: Persistent index bytes
dimensions.scope: SQLite main, retained WAL/SHM, FTS, vector/ANN, and required sidecars by corpus and profile, including bytes per reconciled true fact
dimensions.eligibility: publication, checkpoint, close, retention, truth reconciliation, and fact denominator follow the frozen procedure
dimensions.blocker: no persistent-index result artifacts exist

dimensions.label: Package and compressed artifact bytes
dimensions.scope: default-core binary/package and each optional pack artifact for every release platform
dimensions.eligibility: release stripping, debug-symbol exclusion, compression, platform, digest, and included-file rules are fixed
dimensions.blocker: packaged candidate artifacts and size results do not exist

dimensions.label: Installation transfer bytes
dimensions.scope: clean install, update, repair, rollback, remove, and reinstall for every supported plugin host and release platform
dimensions.eligibility: network and cache state are declared and every transferred managed artifact is counted
dimensions.blocker: clean-host transfer measurements do not exist

dimensions.label: Installed logical bytes
dimensions.scope: default core and each enabled pack on every supported installation target
dimensions.eligibility: managed files, generated config, runtime, skill, registry data, and pack files are inventoried without counting project-local indexes as installation bytes
dimensions.blocker: clean-host installed logical byte results do not exist

dimensions.label: Installed allocated filesystem bytes
dimensions.scope: default core and each enabled pack on every supported filesystem and release platform
dimensions.eligibility: allocated bytes use a named platform metric and are separated from logical and transferred bytes
dimensions.blocker: clean-host allocated filesystem byte results do not exist

dimensions.label: Warm SQLite latency
dimensions.scope: simple indexed name, filter, and one-hop query cells at declared concurrency
dimensions.eligibility: prepared-statement bind through final validated row decode uses an open warmed connection on an eligible reference host
dimensions.blocker: calibration pilot and raw-time eligibility envelope are pending

dimensions.label: Warm service latency
dimensions.scope: simple and bounded-three-hop service cells at declared concurrency and million-node scale
dimensions.eligibility: typed service entry through fully materialized result excludes transport but uses an eligible calibrated reference host
dimensions.blocker: calibration pilot and service measurements are pending

dimensions.label: Warm MCP end-to-end latency
dimensions.scope: simple and bounded-three-hop MCP calls at concurrency 1, 4, and 16 plus the declared mixed workload
dimensions.eligibility: request frame write through validated complete response includes routing, transport, serialization, service, and response delivery on an eligible calibrated host
dimensions.blocker: calibration pilot, candidate implementation, and MCP measurements are pending

dimensions.label: Cold runtime and MCP readiness
dimensions.scope: cold runtime-info completion and cold MCP process start through initialized tool readiness on every release platform
dimensions.eligibility: at least thirty measured launches use fixed packaged artifacts, no surviving process, and the declared cache state
dimensions.blocker: packaged cold-startup results do not exist

dimensions.label: Agent answer quality
dimensions.scope: at least thirty unique blinded paired tasks across the frozen repositories and task families
dimensions.eligibility: model, prompts, tool permissions, budgets, rubric, assignment, grading, attempts, and cluster-aware analysis are pinned
dimensions.blocker: no blinded paired agent-task results exist

dimensions.label: Unsupported agent assertions
dimensions.scope: every frozen repository and task family
dimensions.eligibility: the same blinded paired tasks and retained adjudication used for answer quality are present
dimensions.blocker: no unsupported-assertion results exist

dimensions.label: Per-workflow context tokens
dimensions.scope: startup-orientation, locate, inspect-summary, and exact-slice workflows, each decided independently
dimensions.eligibility: the frozen model, prompts, token counter, response caps, and mandatory call sequence match both baselines
dimensions.blocker: per-workflow token baselines and paired results do not exist

dimensions.label: Per-workflow file reads
dimensions.scope: startup-orientation, locate, inspect-summary, and exact-slice workflows, each decided independently
dimensions.eligibility: read accounting uses the frozen definition and complete tool transcript for both baselines
dimensions.blocker: per-workflow read baselines and paired results do not exist

dimensions.label: Per-workflow tool calls
dimensions.scope: startup-orientation, locate, inspect-summary, and exact-slice workflows, each decided independently
dimensions.eligibility: all calls are captured and the workflow receives no hidden setup or graph-management call
dimensions.blocker: per-workflow call baselines and paired results do not exist

dimensions.label: Mandatory atlas-first call-sequence growth
dimensions.scope: startup-orientation, locate, inspect-summary, and exact-slice workflows
dimensions.eligibility: old-client and current-client workflow replays exercise automatic graph enrichment with no manual graph setup
dimensions.blocker: complete old-client workflow replay is pending

dimensions.label: Production code growth
dimensions.scope: ProjectAtlas-owned production Rust, scripts, schema, and installer policy, separated by crate and generated versus handwritten ownership
dimensions.eligibility: baseline and candidate use the same tracked-file, generated-file, comment, blank-line, fixture, and vendored-code classification
dimensions.blocker: no architecture-cost baseline exists

dimensions.label: Generated code growth
dimensions.scope: generated Rust, registry, schema, fixtures, manifests, and release data reported separately from production code
dimensions.eligibility: generated inputs, outputs, regeneration command, and drift status are present
dimensions.blocker: no generated-code baseline exists

dimensions.label: Crate and dependency growth
dimensions.scope: workspace crates, direct dependencies, transitive dependencies, optional-pack dependency graphs, and dependency cycles, each reported independently
dimensions.eligibility: locked baseline and candidate graphs use equivalent feature and target matrices and every increase has a delivered-capability justification
dimensions.blocker: no locked architecture dependency baseline exists

dimensions.label: Unsafe, native, FFI, and dynamic-library boundaries
dimensions.scope: ProjectAtlas-owned unsafe lines plus every transitive native, unsafe, FFI, dynamic-library, parser, model, ANN, and platform boundary
dimensions.eligibility: ProjectAtlas-owned unsafe remains zero and the complete transitive inventory, advisories, safe-wrapper options, provenance, and platform containment evidence are current
dimensions.blocker: complete transitive audit and hosted packaged-containment proof remain pending in ARRI-11.18, ARRI-11.23, and ARRI-11.28

dimensions.label: Duplicated contract and custom infrastructure owners
dimensions.scope: schema, protocol, status, command, event, mode, storage, query, installer-lifecycle, and capability ownership
dimensions.eligibility: the architecture review traces every owner and reports duplicate or custom owners rather than relying on source-line totals
dimensions.blocker: no current ownership review artifact exists

dimensions.label: Public CLI surface growth
dimensions.scope: commands, aliases, global options, command options, output modes, required config fields, and user installation steps
dimensions.eligibility: generated inventories use the same parser and count each additive surface exactly once
dimensions.blocker: the frozen baseline exists but no phase result exists

dimensions.label: Public MCP surface growth
dimensions.scope: tools, request fields, required arguments, response roots, modes, task surfaces, and normal-workflow calls
dimensions.eligibility: generated inventories cover every registered MCP tool and distinguish optional additive fields from required workflow growth
dimensions.blocker: the frozen baseline exists but no phase result exists

dimensions.label: Plugin-store installation effort
dimensions.scope: clean install, first useful overview, update, repair, rollback, remove, and reinstall on every supported host
dimensions.eligibility: one official store action provisions matching runtime, skill, and MCP registration with zero manual PATH, config, version, or database wiring
dimensions.blocker: ARRI-2.26 plugin-store and host lifecycle feasibility evidence is pending

dimensions.label: Warnings and unresolved blocking reviews
dimensions.scope: format, locked check, strict Clippy, tests/doctests, rustdoc, architecture, Rust, performance, security, storage, platform, KISS, and agent-workflow findings applicable to the phase
dimensions.eligibility: results bind the evaluated commit and every blocking finding has a visible disposition
dimensions.blocker: final v0.4 quality-gate and independent release-review evidence is incomplete

current_phase_exit.next_phase_reason: Phase 0 implementation readiness passes with no claim; final performance, compatibility, hosted-platform, containment, plugin, and packaged evidence remains a Section 11 release gate.

source_blockers: required hosted plugin, platform, containment, and independent-review artifacts are missing
current_release_acceptance.next_phase_reason: v0.4 cannot release until the reproducible baselines, eligible host calibration, full campaigns, accepted final decisions, hosted feasibility and containment evidence, and final review dispositions pass.

one_page_rendering_contract.member_rendering: a dimension row may compact members as passed-over-required plus blocker count, but it must retain a stable evidence link containing every member decision and must print every non-pass member ID when the count fits the one-page target
one_page_rendering_contract.one_page_rule: compact presentation may collapse evidence detail but never collapse, average, omit, or change an independent decision
required_questions: whether the next phase is the smallest independently releasable step
prohibited_output: aggregate pass that hides a non-pass member
green phase status while a required dimension is missing, ineligible, informational, pending, or failing
superiority language without eligible dimension-specific evidence
host-normalized latency produced by dividing by calibration
omission of failures, excluded cells, confidence bounds, methodology version, or evidence links
